name: cascade-vendor-rates
note: Vendor list prices for every unit the cascade meter records. A rate is USD per unit, stated as a decimal string so it loads exactly. A price change adds a new version file; it never edits this one, and a recorded cost keeps the version it was priced with. Every priced rate names its unit, a human-readable source and the vendor price page it came from, plus the date the page was read.

stt.audio_seconds.source: Meta pricing: realtime speech-to-text $0.18 per audio-hour, billed in whole seconds
stt.audio_seconds.note: $0.18 / 3600 s. The meter already records whole seconds, which is the vendor's billing granularity.

llm.prompt_tokens.source: Meta pricing: muse-spark-1.3 Standard $1.25 per 1M input tokens
llm.prompt_tokens.note: Charged on prompt tokens not reported as cached; cached_tokens is a detail of prompt_tokens and is priced by its own line instead.

llm.cached_tokens.source: Meta pricing: muse-spark-1.3 Standard $0.15 per 1M cached input tokens
llm.cached_tokens.note: A cached token is a prompt token billed at the cached rate; it replaces that part of the input charge and is never added on top of it.

llm.completion_tokens.source: Meta pricing: muse-spark-1.3 Standard $4.25 per 1M output tokens
llm.completion_tokens.note: Charged on completion tokens not reported as reasoning; reasoning_tokens is a detail of completion_tokens and is priced by its own line instead.

llm.reasoning_tokens.source: Meta pricing: muse-spark-1.3 Standard $4.25 per 1M output tokens; the page lists no separate reasoning rate
llm.reasoning_tokens.note: The vendor bills reasoning inside completion_tokens, so this line carries the output rate and is not additive to the completion line.

tts.characters.source: AssemblyAI pricing: assemblyai-tts-1 $15 per 1M input characters
tts.characters.note: Billed characters are the vendor's own Termination count (billed_characters over total_input_char_length).

tts.audio_seconds.source: AssemblyAI billing: text-to-speech is billed per character of input text, not per second of audio
tts.audio_seconds.note: A sourced zero, not an absent rate: the vendor reports audio seconds as a fact but does not charge for them.

tts.session_seconds.source: AssemblyAI billing: text-to-speech is billed per character of input text, not per second of session
tts.session_seconds.note: A sourced zero, not an absent rate: the vendor reports session seconds as a fact but does not charge for them.
